sharingCriteriaRules.description: Dispute specialists check what was promised at signing on any customer's dispute, and commitments are master-detail children of Opportunity. Read-only, closed deals only; supervisors get it through the role hierarchy. Collections reps read deals only on accounts in collections, through the account rule. D-02, US-07, DEF-10.
sharingCriteriaRules.label: Closed Won to Dispute Specialists
